title: Vintage Scottish Travel Poster
coreRelationships: The large, bold 'SCOTLAND' text dominates the top, establishing the theme.
The tall, golden tower on the left acts as a strong vertical anchor, contrasting with the horizontal flow of the landscape.
The small, vintage bus on the right mid-ground provides a sense of scale and suggests travel.
The layered, angular mountains in the background create depth and a sense of grandeur.
The 'by SMT' text at the bottom serves as a clear call to action or branding element.
reuseFormula: Generate a stylized travel poster in an Art Deco aesthetic. Use bold, flat color blocks and strong outlines. Feature a prominent, vertically oriented landmark on one side, balanced by a landscape of layered, angular mountains. Include a vintage mode of transport in the mid-ground. Place a large, bold title at the top and a smaller branding element at the bottom. Ensure high color saturation and strong value contrast.
